primary_comparison: candidate vs frozen goal10 scratch+LTO anchor
metric: paired sum-of-two CLI phase wall-time throughput ratios; geometric mean
scope: exploratory, one host/core, serial data sessions; no significance claim

large_variation_gate.rule: audit every row after full run; return nonzero and block promotion if any same-binary same-data phase repeat exceeds this range; do not trim outliers

goal: at least 10 percent aggregate throughput gain in BOTH encode and decode versus fixed anchor; do not compound gains from different studies
selection: compare supplied retained build and candidate directly to fixed anchor; favor larger minimum aggregate gain; screen on requested core, then confirm selected candidate on other core against fixed anchor
